Upon completion of the specialization, learners should have the basis for a comprehensive final project plan.

How long does it take to complete the Specialization? The three courses of this specialization are four, three, and four weeks long, respectively. If you complete the content at the expected pace, it will take 11 weeks to finish.
How long does it take to complete the Specialization?

What background knowledge is necessary? No background knowledge is necessary to begin the specialization. We do recommend, however, that learners new to project management complete the courses in sequence.

Do I need to take the courses in a specific order? Yes. The course team recommends that learners new to project management complete the courses in sequence. However, more experienced learners should feel free to enroll in whichever course is most useful or interesting.
